name: fix-init-gitignore-no-churn-entrypoint-drift
title: Fix koala init gitignore no-churn entrypoint drift
description: Fix the lone red light on a clean main: `npm run test:entrypoints` fails the `koala init` no-churn .gitignore assertion ("runtime ignores already present" missing). Root cause: `scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs` hardcodes a 12-line REQUIRED_RUNTIME_IGNORE_LINES that diverged from `listRuntimeArtifactIgnorePatterns()` after two prior stories added runtime artifacts to the registry — `.koala/locks/` (B-f60c main write lock) and `**/owner-lease.json` (B-c55d story owner lease) — without updating the test seed. `mergeKoalaRuntimeIgnores` now returns `changed=true` on the test's seeded .gitignore, so cli-init prints "merged" instead of the expected "already present" branch. Fix: add the two missing patterns to REQUIRED_RUNTIME_IGNORE_LINES in their canonical registry positions. Out of scope: dynamic import from dist (would add a build dependency to the test script), new contract test to auto-detect future drift (separate structural story), any of the stash@{0} authority / verification-context-pack WIP, any other failing test. One file changed: `scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs`.
